author: Anonymous participant
title: Looking for Ganondorf comfort / yume artist
content: Looking for artist (please READ). I'm looking for artists that can do any of these two options: 1. Typical comfort art (in this case with Ganondorf), where viewer is in 1st sight and the character is looking directly at camera saying sweet things. 2. Pairs, yume. I prefer the Wind Waker version of Ganondorf, but if you can't, Ocarina/remake/Smash Ganondorf or Tears of the Kingdom Ganondorf are fine. PAYING EXCLUSIVELY THROUGH PAYPAL (or vgen, kofi, etc if it accepts paypal). PUT YOUR TAT. IF IT'S MORE THAN 2 WEEKS I'M JUST NOT INTERESTED.

author: Avetetsuya Studios
title: Hiring freelance character, background, and game artists
content: HIRING LOOKING FOR FREELANCE ARTISTS. Avetetsuya Studios is opening opportunities for freelance artists to collaborate on upcoming projects. Seeking: Character Design & Illustration, Character Sprites, Background & Environment Art, Webtoon / Comic Artwork, Game & Digital Art Assets. Apply by sending portfolio and a short intro to avetetsuyastudios@gmail.com with subject Freelance Artist Application – [Your Name]. Include artwork types, art style, availability, and freelance rate.
